notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback! Based on your input, I am rolling out a new update to address as many issues as possible.

- Guide trail now points directly to the next checkpoint instead of level's end.
- Worked on some of the areas towards the end of the octopus level (second level) to avoid frustrating scenarios where things get too ambiguous, player gets stuck, etc.
- Increased stamina a bit for climbing and gliding
- Moved a checkpoint in first level to make guide trail more obvious
- Worked on the splash level's floating rocks labyrinth. Got rid of one way to solve it which was frustrating and unintended. Added an hint.
- Added a text hint about respawning when character is idling.
- Fixed a misplaced critter in the snake level.
- Optimized torch a bit in the cave level. (for better performance on Steam deck, to be confirmed if that is good enough)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: Updated the second level's end: Moved the end level's volume closer to reduce ambiguity about where to go. Before, you had to stay on the octopus for a while to reach the end of the level, now this happens much faster.

notes.title: Multi-Language Demo Update: Available Until February 25
notes.content:
"Chasing the Unseen" will officially support English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French, Portuguese, German and Spanish.
The Demo is now accessible in those languages.

Limited Time Demo Availability:
Players should note that the demo will only be available on the Steam store until February 25, 2024.

Release date:
"Chasing the Unseen" will hit Steam on March 7, 2024.
